{{Quote|The law says when you deal with a demon you must expect to get burned.|[[Foolookoola]]|<ref name="Deal with a Demon">{{Tales|3|Deal with a Demon}}</ref>}}
'''Demon''' was a generic term for a malevolent supernatural creature, which was used to refer to creatures in a number of cultures' mythologies. The term '''devil''' was also used. Worlds which had some form of demon myth included [[Somov Rit]] (the [[swamp demon]]),<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith 1|''Jedi vs. Sith'' 1]]</ref> [[Ootoola]],<ref name="Deal with a Demon" /> and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] (the [[Cacodemon]]).<ref name="The Monster">{{GamerCite|2|The Monster}}''</ref> It is unknown if they were somewhat related to the mythological [[Chaos/Legends|Hell]], though some cultures would qualify demonic creatures as ''hell-spawned''.

Before the birth of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], many lone [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] were regarded as demons by those who did not understand their powers.<ref name="WDM">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

In a thousand different myths, demons sported horns<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> (just like the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] entity [[Smoke Demon]]),<ref name="annual">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 1]]</ref> which led many species to feel discomfort when meeting [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]].<ref name="Guide" /> With her red skin, horns and fiery eyes, the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Darth Cognus]] was also compared to a demon.<ref name="DOE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Ganne]] was shocked by the appearance of the [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], believing him to be something akin to a devil.<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>

[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was considered to have turned into a demon after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], although it was also believed he may have been a demon all along.<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

[[Suzal]] referred to [[Wutzek]] as a demon.<ref name="TPE">{{StoryCite|story=The Pandora Effect|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151}}</ref>

The word "demon" was often used in the names of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that operated throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
